title: Chapter for entering and for coming forth out of the Netherworld

verses.t: Chapter for entering and for coming forth out of the Netherworld.
Salutation to thee, O Râ, who guardest the secrets of the gates over this domain of Seb, and this Balance with which Râ raiseth up Maât daily:
Here am I, who cleave open the earth, grant that I may come and acquire advance in age.
